authorization: User explicitly resumed public primary-source discovery and alternative routes; no outreach. Earlier evidence impasse is not treated as exhaustion of all public research.
primary_action: One bounded discovery pass for newly identified primary records capable of constraining readings through independent referents or measurements
routes: Named or aligned-content inscriptions in overseas administrative contexts
Inscribed artifacts joined to independently identified contents, residue or original sealing events
Inscribed measured weights or vessels with artifact-level numerical referents
bound: At most12 distinct search queries total,4 per route; preserve exact query/results captures. Primary publishers,museums,excavation teams,institutional repositories preferred. novelty_check: Check specific selected pointer against retained source registry and route log. Do not repeat closed requests or parameter sweeps without specific new body/pointer or documented defect.

Independent known content,sound,quantity or original-use observation
finite_stop: Twelve-query discovery bound or a sufficiently specific primary pointer merits one gate. Record unqualified leads without treating search results as reading anchors; finish discovery before opening another broad route.
exclusions: No phonetic fitting or corpus amendment
